newsitem.title: UK: Colombia considering stg Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Colombia considering stg Eurobond issue.

text.p: Colombia is considering a sterling-denominated Eurobond issue after a number of other such deals from Latin American countries, syndicate sources said on Monday.
"Having seen the (sterling) deals out for Mexico and Argentina -- and a mandate for Brazil -- Colombia is also interested in talking to people about such a transaction," a syndicate manager said.
"They're taking market soundings right now," he added.
Dealers said Colombia could launch a bond of up to 150 million stg with a 10-year maturity.
Brazil is expected to launch a 150-200 million stg 10-year Eurobond via BZW and CSFB in the next two weeks. Unofficial price talk has ranged between 260 and 275 basis points over gilts.
This month Argentina launched a 200 million stg 10-year Eurobond via HSBC and UBS. The bond was priced to yield 280 basis points over gilts.
And in the five-year sterling sector, Mexico launched a 300 million stg bond in May via BZW and SBC Warburg. The deal was priced to yield 175 b.p. over gilts.
